text: When an actuator stays at its limit, accumulated integral error can keep the controller saturated after conditions change. Anti-windup methods limit this accumulation.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: John D. Hedengren, APMonitor Process Dynamics and Control, PID lesson; https://apmonitor.com/pdc/index.php/Main/ProportionalIntegralDerivative. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A digital PID controller replaces a continuous integral with a sum and estimates rate of change from successive samples. The sample interval is part of the calculation.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: John D. Hedengren, APMonitor Process Dynamics and Control, PID lesson; https://apmonitor.com/pdc/index.php/Main/ProportionalIntegralDerivative. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A controller can request more output than an actuator can supply. Clipping the command at the physical limits changes the behavior of the feedback loop.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: John D. Hedengren, APMonitor Process Dynamics and Control, PID lesson; https://apmonitor.com/pdc/index.php/Main/ProportionalIntegralDerivative. Consulted 2026-10-13.
